research_question: Does a two-resolution, certified endpoint correction improve the fixed common-assessor result, rather than merely adding callback work after the same LM-QR trajectory?

cpqr_candidate.eligibility: finite, in bounds, semantics valid, and declared-scale residual linf <=1e-12
cpqr_candidate.jacobians: h and h/2; central or a common second-order same-side one-sided stencil
cpqr_candidate.stencil_failure: UNKNOWN and drop the otherwise qualified endpoint
cpqr_candidate.line_search: finer step with alpha in [1,1/2,1/4,1/8], bounds/semantics-valid Armijo
cpqr_candidate.final_gate: after any accepted correction repeat the h/h2 proof; when the endpoint is unchanged the current proof is the final proof; always explicitly recheck finite/bounds/semantics-signature/residual-linf

shadow_contract: Each shadow executes the identical base/correction trajectory and callback work but returns the original LM-QR endpoint.

execution.threshold_policy: snapshot after the first completed attempt crossing each threshold
execution.stop_policy: stop a case/variant at cumulative callbacks >=4800 or 64 starts
execution.primary_work: earliest suffix-stable common-assessor safe-full callbacks; miss or >4800 right-censored to 4800
execution.sharding: one representative case per process; --case-index=1..9; at most 9 processes pinned to CPU 0..8

candidate_vs_own_shadow.callback_identity: all paired attempts must report identical observed callback counts
candidate_vs_own_shadow.cpqr_safety: CPQR must have fewer unsafe common-assessor endpoints than its shadow, or both must have zero
candidate_vs_own_shadow.svd_safety: SVD must have zero unsafe endpoints and must strictly remove at least one unsafe endpoint returned by its shadow, as required by EXP-LOCAL-011

promotion_gate.active_structure_definition: a family counts only if at least one paired candidate endpoint differs from its shadow and either drops an unsafe shadow endpoint or remains common-assessor qualified, Gold-consistent, unambiguous, and matched to the same target as the shadow
promotion_gate.cpqr_svd_disagreement: report every endpoint class, safety, recall, or work disagreement; do not silently select by result

promotion_scope: A passing T0 authorizes only a separately frozen T1/T2 decision; it is not production promotion.
